args.text: Can you pull every ticket and feature request on Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Driftmoor Marine Freight from the Coastal channels and Moss's Coastal notes, labelled by account? Leave Pellow Home Living out even though it shares the PHL code. I need the list for Kwame's account review.

Bettina, here's what I found on the two accounts. Sources: #coastal-team, #coastal-random, and Moss's four Coastal digests. There's nothing on either account in the two channels, so everything below comes from the digests. I also used your own Pellucid cutover note.

*Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast)*
• Ticket #4419: the `Yard_Dwell_Summary` report times out when filtered by container length. Moss's cheat sheet lists it as open.
• Ticket #PD-8841: Pemberline Dock chassis pool holds on double-booked gates, with screenshots from Gate 4B. This comes from your Dec 8 cutover note, not Moss's.
• No ticket number was given for these, so they may not be formal tickets:
  – Chassis pool validation at Gate 4 during shift change, which the cheat sheet calls the main friction point.
  – The Berth 2 yard map CSV import bug, from your cutover note.
  – The Gate 4B printer mapping, also from your cutover note.
  – The terminal 4 drayage gate export, queued for the 11/3 handoff (Moss's 11/2 digest).

*Driftmoor Marine Freight (Puget Sound)*
• Feature request #882: warehouse managers want a bulk-clear button for departed barges (cheat sheet).
• Tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B. Engineering gave a manual CSV patch for the night dispatcher (cheat sheet). No ticket number.
• Request for a patched manifest CSV before the 06:00 shift (Moss's 11/2 digest). No ticket number. It may be the same issue as the tide-table patch, but the notes don't say so.

*One thing to check:* Moss's 11/2 digest puts ticket #4419 under Kwame's port account ("barge slip 7 schedule sync") in the Puget Sound Operations entry, next to Driftmoor's request. The cheat sheet puts #4419 on Pellucid's report timeout. I can't tell from the notes which is right, so check #4419 before the review. I've left it under Pellucid for now.

*Left out:* Pellow Home Living, which is PD-4821 and #8812 and is the account formerly called Covey & Lark Retail. I also left out Saltmarsh Provisions, which isn't one of your two accounts.

Moss's notes are dated 2025-10 to 2026-05, so anything newer won't be here. I can't see the account ticket folders from here, so Kwame may want to check the ticket system for the current status.

I've posted the list for Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Driftmoor Marine Freight as a reply in your #coastal-team thread, labelled by account.

- **Sources:** Nothing on either account is in #coastal-team or #coastal-random. All of it comes from Moss's Coastal digests, plus your own Pellucid cutover note, which I flagged as not being Moss's.
- **Pellucid Harbor Logistics:** Ticket #4419 and ticket #PD-8841 have numbers. I also listed four items with no ticket number, such as the Gate 4 chassis pool validation issue.
- **Driftmoor Marine Freight:** Feature request #882 has a number. There are two other items with no number: the tide-table import macro failure and the patched manifest CSV request.
- **Conflict to check:** Moss's 11/2 digest puts #4419 under Kwame's port account, as a barge slip 7 schedule sync issue. The cheat sheet puts #4419 on Pellucid's report timeout. I left it under Pellucid and told you to check it before the review.
- **Left out:** Pellow Home Living (PD-4821 and #8812) and Saltmarsh Provisions.
- **Limits:** Moss's notes run only from October 2025 to May 2026. I can't see the account ticket folders, so Kwame should check the ticket system for current status.
